Successful SMTP authentication from unusual IP
Email requesting large wire transfer outside normal business hours
No MFA enabled for executive email account
Email headers with internal IP 10.1.5.23 but SMTP logs show external IP used for login
Domain SPF, DKIM, and DMARC pass but originating IP is suspicious
Wire transfer details in email body not matching prior legitimate requests
examples.detection_method: Correlate executive login IP addresses with known user behavior baselines; alert on login from new geolocations or unusual times. Monitor SMTP and IMAP login logs for anomalous IPs. Monitor email content for high-risk keywords (e.g., 'wire transfer', 'urgent', 'account number') combined with executive accounts. Enforce MFA and detect disabled MFA. Validate wire transfer requests with out-of-band confirmation (phone call). Use UEBA (User and Entity Behavior Analytics) to flag unusual communication patterns.
